summary: Prototype private workspaces: owner-only access, identical create/update validation, bounded payload, server timestamp, monotonic revision, deny-by-default. Emulator attack tests and save/restore/conflict checks passed. Not a comprehensive production security certification.

findings.issue: Rules validate the payload string envelope, not the internal JSON. An owner can corrupt only their own payload through direct SDK access; the client validates before loading and preserves originals.
findings.recommendation: Use typed documents and per-field rules or a server validation layer if data must be trusted outside the owner workspace. Never interpret payload roles or owner fields as authority.

findings.issue: One bounded document per UID limits individual payload size but does not prevent account farming or repeated authenticated writes. App Check and backend rate limits are not enabled.
findings.recommendation: Review usage quotas, abuse monitoring and App Check before broad release; test provider and server rate limits before enabling social auth.
